title: Led the first CI/CD milestone: automated end-to-end tests
summary: I led the first milestone of the CI/CD drive I had set for identity management in 2019: the team's end-to-end test automation running through Jenkins.
what_would_have_happened: End-to-end tests ran by hand, so every release waited on manual checks.
the_call: Automate the slowest check first, then build the pipeline around it.
what_i_did: Set the milestone and led the contributors who got the end-to-end scripts running through Jenkins.
what_changed: The director thanked all the contributors and named it the first step of the CI/CD pipeline drive.

quotes.text: I would like to thank all the contributors in the first step of our initiative. This is very crucial step in the CI CD PIPELINE DRIVE.
